description: The bar chart illustrates two sets of data: Accuracy (%) and Token Count. The horizontal axis represents different methods, labeled as CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT. The vertical axis on the left measures accuracy in percentage, ranging from 70% to 100%, while the vertical axis on the right measures token count, ranging from 0 to 800. The accuracy data is represented by bars in red, orange, blue, and green, with the following values: CoT at 91.19%, CoD at 80.89%, CCoT at 88.40%, and CoUT at 674.85%. The token count data is represented by bars in the same colors, with the following values: CoT at 445.91, CoD at 534.24, CCoT at 354.46, and CoUT at 676.85. The bars are arranged in pairs, with each method's accuracy and token count represented side by side. The chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
